items.q: How do major and minor keys typically sound?
items.correct: Major often sounds bright/happy; minor often sounds darker/sadder.
items.why: The pattern of tones and semitones differs, giving major and minor their characteristic moods.

items.q: What is the difference between melody and harmony?
items.correct: Melody is the tune; harmony is notes sounded together to support it.
items.random_wrong: Harmony is always played by drums.
items.why: A melody is a single line of pitches; harmony is the accompanying chords/notes.
